svg.title: San Telmo, RICPE and Sun Park: two professional lives in parallel
svg.desc: Source-controlled public English rendering of the statement and its evidential limits.

div.h1: San Telmo partner Eduardo Sánchez stated that “the firm” introduced clients into the RICPE investment connected, according to the supplied reconstruction, with Sun Park.

div.div: ONE COMPLEX. ONE HISTORIC PROFESSIONAL PERIMETER. TWO PROFESSIONAL LIVES IN PARALLEL.

div.h2:
SUN PARK / MYND YAIZA
SAME COMPLEX · FRAGMENTED TITLES

FRANCISCO DE BORJA
RODRÍGUEZ-BATLLORI LAFFITTE
INSOLVENCY ADMINISTRATOR · 36/2012

div.p: “bueno, nosotros en el despacho… en esa primera inversión… metimos unos cuantos clientes”

div.div:
SOURCE: “Enrique Guerra, en #UnCaféenSanTelmo” · San Telmo Abogados y Economistas · 30 Nov 2021
Statement 08:08–08:12 · reviewed context 07:57–08:27 · direct video: youtube.com/watch?v=mHn9IJU0qI4&t=488s
WHAT CONFLICT, MATTER-SEPARATION, KYC, ACCESS AND INFORMATION CONTROLS EXISTED — AND WHERE ARE THE RECORDS?

DIRECT STATEMENT CONTROLLED BY SOURCES.
It establishes the statement and justifies traceability questions. It does not by itself establish coordination, transfer of insolvency information, unlawfulness or liability.
